window: 10-16s in the first high-height/mu.5 stop; all four lanes completed this window
structural_finding: At zero requested planar command, when rolling<.15m/s and |gyro_yaw|<.45rad/s, v12 motion_gate is zero, conditioned reference is not selected, and the trainable directional banks have exactly zero action derivative. Yaw error above the .1rad/s criterion can therefore be outside their authority.
causal_limit: This proves missing local training authority for these recorded states; it does not prove it is the sole cause of failed start-stop completion or that a lower threshold will preserve standing.
